name: coordinator-monitor
description: One pane for every local Claude Code session: sessions, subagents (savvy-flow aware), pending permissions and questions you can answer in place.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting; en or it

coordinatorFolder.title: Coordinator folder
coordinatorFolder.description: Name of the folder the coordinator session runs in: the pane opens by itself there and that session never forwards its own questions. Empty: open the pane with /agents-monitor.

forwardQuestions.title: Forward questions to the pane
forwardQuestions.description: on: a session's multiple-choice questions and its '## Questions for you' section go to the pane; off: they stay in the session

busDir.title: Shared folder
busDir.description: Where sessions publish their status. Empty: ~/.claude/coordinator-monitor
